name: Realtime social timeline / Define the success contract

intent.outcome: Design a real-time social timeline where users follow accounts and receive fresh home feeds.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Finite users and explicit follow relationships, bounded timeline retention and synthetic reads. No X production ranking or real WebSocket delivery.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.

concepts.label: Users and requests
concepts.responsibility: Who issues requests, and which identities or deadlines travel with them?

concepts.label: System responsibility
concepts.responsibility: Design a real-time social timeline where users follow accounts and receive fresh home feeds.
